D1.NAME: STRUCTURAL_STATE_DETECTION
D1.MECHANISM_CLASS: Low-dimensional, price-derived, discrete state representation of BTC's own path.
D1.INFORMATION_SOURCE: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 price path only; no new acquisition.
D1.FUNCTION: State detection (NOT alpha/return prediction). Asks whether a frozen, low-DoF discrete state construction shows transition/persistence structure beyond a defensible lower-order null.
D1.TARGET_FAMILY: Discrete state labels / transition-persistence structure. Explicitly no return, MAE, or alpha target.
D1.TIME_SCALE: Single frozen time scale, chosen outcome-blind before inspection.
D1.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One bar/window on the frozen time scale, CORE BTC only.
D1.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect precondition study only. A positive state model is explicitly NOT itself an edge claim.
D1.SIMPLE_BASELINE: A frozen lower-order surrogate/null preserving every structure the claim does not intend to label as regime structure (see NULL_MODEL_RISK below); must be chosen outcome-blind.
D1.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Exactly one state-construction class; no cluster shopping; no sweeping k values; no trying multiple feature families and keeping the prettiest; no horizon/window selection after label inspection.
D1.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 price path was adaptively used by H01/H02 (dev window 2020-02-01 -> 2025-01-01) and confirmatorily consumed by MARKET-01/02/05/06, but never previously for a state-detection FUNCTION -- prior exposure is to the data tier, not to this analytical function.
D1.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Only the tested class of low-dimensional, price-derived, discrete state representations at the frozen time scale and construction procedure. Does NOT close continuous conditioning, other discrete-state constructions, other time scales, cross-sectional structure, order-book/liquidity regimes, latent states using information outside CORE BTC, or 'BTC regimes' generally.
D1.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Proposing (not creating) a future confirmatory hypothesis that conditions a downstream target on the detected state, subject to its own information-gain and feasibility review.
D1.RESEARCHER_DOF: HIGH -- the primary blocker. Cluster shopping, k selection, and feature-window choice are the dominant risk.
D1.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: One state-construction implementation plus one frozen surrogate/null implementation; no additional feature families.

NULL_MODEL_RISK.insufficient_null_warning: A null preserving only unconditional marginal distribution + linear autocorrelation/spectrum is NOT automatically acceptable if the candidate representation uses volatility clustering, vol-of-vol, realized-volatility term structure, path roughness, or nonlinear temporal dependence -- such a null can mechanically destroy the very second-order dependence under test and manufacture a guaranteed positive contrast.
NULL_MODEL_RISK.requirement: The null must preserve every lower-order structure that the claim does not intend to label as regime structure, and may destroy only the structure under test.
NULL_MODEL_RISK.selection_rule: the surrogate/null family must be chosen outcome-blind, never after seeing label persistence

D2.NAME: CONDITIONAL_ABSTENTION_TAIL_RISK
D2.MECHANISM_CLASS: Conditional abstention / tail-risk filtering, drawing on the same observable families MARKET-05/06 tested as additive predictors.
D2.INFORMATION_SOURCE: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 own-state observables and the cross-asset/cross-venue observables previously used by MARKET-05 and MARKET-06.
D2.FUNCTION: Filtering / risk reduction (NOT scalar prediction). Asks whether a simple abstention rule built on these observables changes the distribution of adverse-path exposure on days it fires, relative to unfiltered days.
D2.TARGET_FAMILY: Filtered-vs-unfiltered adverse-path exposure distributions. Explicitly no additive-linear-term / MAE-improvement target -- that exact cell is REPEATED_NULL / LOW_PRIORITY_FOR_NOW and this card must not reintroduce it.
D2.TIME_SCALE: Same 24h horizon MARKET-05/06 used, reused only as a time scale, not as the same function.
D2.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One day (BTC daily grid), same as MARKET-05/06.
D2.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect. Even a promising filter is an exploratory screen, not an edge claim or a rescue of MARKET-05/06's null result.
D2.SIMPLE_BASELINE: PRIMARY comparator: RATE_MATCHED_RANDOM_ABSTENTION -- a random abstention control that abstains on the same number/share of decision rows as the candidate rule, with temporal composition matched where feasible (e.g. matched within year/regime bucket). This tests whether the rule selects WHICH exposures to avoid better than chance, not merely whether taking less exposure differs from taking all exposure. The unconditional (never-abstain) adverse-path exposure distribution over the same period may remain only as a SECONDARY reference, never the primary comparator.
D2.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: At most one or two frozen, pre-stated abstention-threshold rules per observable family already used in MARKET-05/06; no new observable families; no threshold sweep beyond the pre-stated set.
D2.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: The observable families and the 2020-2024 surface were adaptively used by H01/H02 and confirmatorily consumed by MARKET-05 (MARKET_05_NO_EVIDENCE) and MARKET-06 (MARKET_06_NO_EVIDENCE) at the additive-linear-term FUNCTION. This card explicitly does NOT claim those nulls are 'rescued' -- it tests a materially different FUNCTION (filtering) on the same information source.
D2.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Filtering/abstention use of these specific observable families at this horizon, independent of and in addition to their already-established null as additive predictors.
D2.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Proposing a future confirmatory abstention-rule hypothesis on an independent surface (per CONFIRMATORY_FEASIBILITY -- the 2020-2024 exposure means this cannot itself be confirmatory evidence).
D2.RESEARCHER_DOF: MEDIUM-HIGH -- threshold choice and rule construction are constrained by SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE but abstention rules are easy to overfit post hoc.
D2.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: Reuse of existing MARKET-05/06 observable-construction code; one filtering-rule evaluation script; no new data acquisition.
D2.supersession_note: This card is the explicit exercise of the a711086 R-B routing correction in HYPOTHESIS_DISCOVERY_PIPELINE_V2: R-B may be explored on historically exposed data under DISCOVERY_FEASIBILITY; any resulting pattern remains exploratory and requires an independent future confirmation surface.

baseline_correction_2026_09_21.kind: pre-outcome design correction; no scientific outcome computed

D3.NAME: PATH_MORPHOLOGY
D3.MECHANISM_CLASS: Trajectory / path characterization of BTC price paths over a fixed forward window.
D3.FUNCTION: Trajectory/path characterization (NOT terminal-return prediction). Examples: adverse/favorable excursion magnitude, time-to-extreme, path asymmetry.
D3.TARGET_FAMILY: Path-shape functionals (excursion, time-to-extreme, asymmetry) conditioned on a simple, frozen prior-state descriptor. Must NOT reduce to predicting the terminal 24h return/MAE -- if a candidate functional collapses to that, the card must be reported INVALID_DISCOVERY, not silently redefined.
D3.TIME_SCALE: Same 24h forward window used elsewhere in the program, for comparability, but scored on path shape, not terminal value.
D3.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One forward-looking 24h path per decision time.
D3.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect. Path-shape knowledge could plausibly inform future execution/risk work, but this card makes no such claim.
D3.SIMPLE_BASELINE: Path-shape statistics of an unconditional (state-blind) sample of 24h paths over the same period.
D3.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: At most two or three pre-stated path functionals; no functional-family fishing; no post hoc redefinition of 'excursion' after inspecting results.
D3.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 24h-forward windows were used by MARKET-05/06 for a terminal adverse-path MAE target, but never previously for a path-SHAPE functional -- prior exposure is to the data/window, not to this FUNCTION.
D3.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Path-shape functionals as a useful conditioning target at this horizon and data tier, independent of terminal-value prediction.
D3.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Proposing a future confirmatory path-morphology hypothesis, with its own fresh-surface and feasibility review.
D3.RESEARCHER_DOF: MEDIUM -- functional choice is the main risk, bounded by SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE.
D3.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: Path-functional computation script reusing existing bar-construction code; no new data acquisition.

execution_bound_2026_09_21.requirement: NOT EXECUTABLE until exactly one prior-state descriptor (or an explicit unconditional design) is frozen outcome-blind.
execution_bound_2026_09_21.prohibition: No selecting a descriptor after viewing path-morphology results.
execution_bound_2026_09_21.note: The descriptor is deliberately NOT chosen in this corrective unit; choosing it is a separate future step that must itself be outcome-blind.

D4.NAME: BTC_ETH_RELATIVE_STRUCTURE
D4.MECHANISM_CLASS: Two-asset relative/relational structure between BTC and ETH.
D4.INFORMATION_SOURCE: CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 and CORE_ETH price paths (the only two instruments with an existing core historical tier).
D4.FUNCTION: Relative relationship characterization (e.g. lead-lag, relative strength, co-movement regime), explicitly a two-asset exploratory precursor only.
D4.TARGET_FAMILY: BTC-ETH relative structure functionals. Not a cross-sectional panel statistic.
D4.TIME_SCALE: Same time scale conventions as D1/D3 for comparability, chosen outcome-blind.
D4.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One BTC-ETH paired observation per decision time.
D4.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect. Any pattern found is a two-asset curiosity, not evidence about a broader cross-sectional structure.
D4.SIMPLE_BASELINE: Unconditional BTC-ETH correlation/co-movement statistic over the same period.
D4.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: At most one or two pre-stated relative-structure functionals; no combinatorial lag search.
D4.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: CORE_BTC and CORE_ETH price tiers exist in the repository from prior work, but no prior MARKET unit has tested BTC-ETH relative structure as a FUNCTION.
D4.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Simple BTC-ETH pairwise relative-structure functionals as a useful mechanism, at this time scale.
D4.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Motivating the case for eventually funding real cross-sectional panel acquisition (see CROSS_SECTIONAL_PANEL_FEASIBILITY sidecar) -- NOT a claim that two-asset relative structure equals cross-sectional (R-C) evidence.
D4.RESEARCHER_DOF: MEDIUM -- functional and lag choice, bounded by SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE.
D4.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: One relative-structure computation script reusing existing CORE BTC/ETH loaders; no new data acquisition.
D4.explicit_limitation: This card is explicitly NOT equivalent to true cross-sectional panel evidence (R-C). It is a two-asset precursor only.

D5.NAME: COMPOSED_DECISION_MECHANISM
D5.MECHANISM_CLASS: Composed rule/filter combining two or more already-explored observable families into one decision mechanism.
D5.INFORMATION_SOURCE: Observable families already used in MARKET-01/02/05/06 and/or D1-D4, composed rather than searched for anew.
D5.FUNCTION: Composed rule/filter (NOT combinatorial interaction mining). A very small, frozen search surface: the composition itself must be pre-stated before any inspection.
D5.TARGET_FAMILY: Filtered/composed decision outcome, mirroring D2's filtering framing but across more than one observable family.
D5.TIME_SCALE: Same 24h horizon used elsewhere in the program, for comparability.
D5.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: One day (BTC daily grid), same as D2/MARKET-05/06.
D5.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect and explicitly high-risk: composed/interaction claims are the easiest to construct after the fact to look meaningful.
D5.SIMPLE_BASELINE: Each individual component rule evaluated alone (i.e. the composition must beat its best individual component, not just beat doing nothing).
D5.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Exactly one pre-stated composition of exactly two pre-stated component rules; no combinatorial search over which components to combine; no interaction mining across the full observable set.
D5.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: Every component observable family has already been adaptively and/or confirmatorily used on the 2020-2024 surface (MARKET-01/02/05/06, H01/H02). This card composes previously-tested pieces; it does not introduce a new information source.
D5.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: This specific pre-stated two-component composition as a useful decision mechanism -- narrow, by design, given the high rescue risk of this mechanism class.
D5.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Extremely cautious: a future confirmatory test would require an independent surface AND explicit multiple-testing accounting across everything already tried in this program at this cell. A positive result here alone does not justify skipping that accounting.
D5.RESEARCHER_DOF: HIGH -- composed/interaction mechanisms carry the highest post hoc rescue and multiple-testing risk in the sprint; this is recorded explicitly, not minimized.
D5.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: One composition-evaluation script reusing existing component implementations; no new observable families; no parameter retuning of the component rules.
D5.supersession_note: This card is the explicit exercise of the a711086 R-F routing correction in HYPOTHESIS_DISCOVERY_PIPELINE_V2: R-F may be explored only under a tightly bounded search surface, with HIGH rescue/multiple-testing risk explicitly recorded, not merely because individually-null variables might interact.

D6.NAME: EXTERNAL_MECHANISM_BENCHMARK
D6.MECHANISM_CLASS: Externally/publicly sourced mechanism used diagnostically to calibrate the discovery process itself, not to search for a new internal edge.
D6.INFORMATION_SOURCE: A publicly documented external mechanism or strategy, materially different in construction from the MARKET-03 external reproduction.
D6.FUNCTION: Diagnostic benchmark reproduction -- used to check whether the discovery process (search surface, baseline, prototype gate) correctly identifies a mechanism already known externally to have some structure, calibrating false-negative risk in the process itself.
D6.TARGET_FAMILY: Whatever target family the external source itself defines, reproduced as faithfully as feasible.
D6.TIME_SCALE: Whatever time scale the external source defines.
D6.UNIT_OF_OBSERVATION: Whatever unit of observation the external source defines.
D6.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Diagnostic only. This card exists to calibrate the discovery pipeline, not to add an internal edge candidate.
D6.SIMPLE_BASELINE: The external source's own stated naive/unconditional comparator, where available.
D6.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: Reproduction of the externally specified mechanism only; no internal variant search.
D6.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: Materially different from MARKET-03 (which reproduced a specific public strategy scored on author max-drawdown direction); this card's external source and construction must be chosen to differ materially, not merely renamed.
D6.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: Nothing about internal mechanism-space priority -- a null here says only that this external benchmark did not reproduce as expected, which is itself diagnostic information about the pipeline's sensitivity.
D6.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: Confidence calibration only: evidence that the discovery pipeline's SIMPLE_BASELINE/SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE/prototype-gate design is not so conservative that it would miss a mechanism known to have real structure. This must NOT be recorded as an internal discovery success.
D6.RESEARCHER_DOF: LOW -- the mechanism is externally specified, minimizing internal construction freedom.
D6.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: One reproduction script following the external source's published methodology; no internal extension.
D6.explicit_note: This card must NOT count toward INTERNAL_DISCOVERY_CARDS or INTERNAL_PROMISING_PROTOTYPES in the program diagnostic. It belongs only to EXTERNAL_BENCHMARK_CARDS / EXTERNAL_PROMISING_OR_REPRODUCED, exactly as MARKET-03 belongs only to external evidence/history.
